name: Dhruv Rastogi
description:
Dhruv Rastogi is a mobile and backend engineer at [Infinisync.ai](http://Infinisync.ai) and the founder of [Scrolling.in](http://Scrolling.in), with 2+ years of experience building and shipping production applications across Flutter, native Android, iOS, React Native, and backend technologies. He has worked on five apps published on the Play Store and App Store, including a banking module serving 100K+ customers and an Android NFC integration for physical badge hardware.

A Google Summer of Code 2025 Flutter contributor and 2026 mentor at FOSSASIA, Dhruv contributes to open-source projects such as Magic ePaper, Badge Magic, and PSLab. He is also an IEEE-published author, passionate about exploring new technologies and building impactful products.
